purpose: Require vegetation ecology and the physically dimensioned tree-to-ground root-zone interface in every formal Unity 4K/temporal candidate after detailed-tree reconstruction. The integration contract mirrors the authoritative ecology/root-zone contracts so formal evidence cannot silently accept stale counts or a simplified tree-ground interface.

tree_pit_interface.intent: Size the maintained opening from the generated mature root-flare envelope, keep all root geometry inside exposed soil, seat every precast curb module on its local paving/lawn support grade, and ground low understory into its actual support surface without changing gameplay colliders.

interfaces: tree trunk/root flare to exposed root-zone soil
root-zone soil to inner precast curb face on four maintained paved pits
precast curb modules to local plaza paving or lawn support grade
two grass-ground trees directly to lawn without an artificial paved collar
understory stems to final soil or grass support datum
construction_reasoning.orientation_and_exposure: All ecology placement remains deterministic and scene-context driven relative to the six benchmark tree slots, plaza/lawn boundary, circulation pressure and coherent midsummer environment.

soil.weathering_rule: No wetness, black contact halo or decorative runoff may be introduced without a causal catchment/contact condition.

paved_interface.angular_response: Broad subdued dielectric grazing response must come from physical chamfer plus illumination, never a painted highlight.

grass_and_understory.angular_response: Two-sided leaf response and modest transmission under the coherent midsummer sun; no emissive or baked rim light.

rules: Root-zone compaction and soil variation originate at trunk/contact/circulation zones.
Paving-edge discoloration or accumulation may follow drainage/contact geometry but may not be placed as decorative random stains.
Vegetation density is reduced toward pedestrian-pressure sources and remains compatible with the supporting surface.
Dry benchmark materials remain dry unless a later state supplies a physically plausible water source and retention path.

lod_and_temporal_policy.root_zone_note: Root flares remain represented through tree LOD0/1/2/3; maintained pit substrate/curb are static construction geometry; understory uses animated cross-fade. Actual pop/shimmer judgement remains render-only.

fail_closed_rules: FAIL if VegetationEcologyDetail or any of the six deterministic ecology patches is absent after the formal foliage rebuild.
FAIL if the ecology contract is not validated before ecology construction.
FAIL if maintained pit count is not exactly four or grass-ground tree count is not exactly two.
FAIL if any maintained pit does not contain exactly twelve curb modules or if the opening/root-clearance dimensions drift from the root-zone contract.
FAIL if the root-zone interface validator does not pass in the same formal scene candidate.
FAIL if legacy/simple tree-pit geometry remains where the root-zone reconstruction is required.
FAIL if required materials, contact metadata, cause-based weathering reasoning or construction provenance are missing.
FAIL if formal validation can pass after deleting the ecology root, a required root-zone reconstruction, or required understory LOD state.
Do not self-repair after reflection/render evidence has been armed; rebuild before the formal evidence epoch instead.

required_stills: 3840x2160 hero/frontal where vegetation interfaces are visible
render_verification.required_temporal: native-resolution camera motion crossing relevant tree and understory LOD ranges

implementation_readiness.reason_not_higher: Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime, formal pass execution, failure injection and actual 4K evidence are not currently available from a Runner.
